comparability.description: Whether primary_measurement is interpretable beyond this one ordering. within_query_only means the scores rank these candidates against each other and nothing else: they are not comparable across queries, carry no null model, and an unrelated sequence can produce a higher top score than a true homolog, so no score threshold is meaningful. cross_query_calibrated means a qualified calibration produced significance for every returned candidate, and significance.measurements is the field to threshold on.

data.description: The same candidate representation returned by inline homology search.

expires_at.description: RFC 3339 instant after which this immutable result set is no longer retrievable through the retained-search API.

id.description: Opaque immutable identity of the exact target population searched.

reason.description: Why significance is missing. no_qualified_calibration is also the unavailable_reason the release catalog publishes for the same release, so the two surfaces name this with one string.

bit_score.description: Database-size-independent score from the fitted tail: (lambda*raw_score - ln k)/ln 2. When support_status is supported_tail_model the identity expected_false_hits = searched_sequence_count * 2^-bit_score holds exactly. In the counted regime the probability comes from the empirical null instead, so treat bit_score there as the same score on a comparable scale, not as a restatement of expected_false_hits.

e_value_calibration_id.description: Immutable E-value model identity; distinct from the enclosing augmented calibration_id.

e_value_conditioning_context_id.description: Identity of the pre-score query covariates used by a conditional model.

e_value_estimand.description: Null count represented by expected_false_hits, such as exhaustive target hits or rows reported by one frozen procedure.

e_value_method.description: Exact qualified construction used for expected_false_hits.

e_value_tail_coordinate.description: Standardized conditional-tail excess used to enforce the qualified support boundary.

expected_false_hits.description: Qualified expected null-hit count for the declared E-value estimand and exact searched inventory. Comparable in units, but not model assumptions, to a BLAST E-value.

is_family_wise_lower_bound.description: True when a null replay frontier truncated above this score, making family_wise_exceedance_probability a lower bound.

log_expected_false_hits.description: Natural logarithm of expected_false_hits; authoritative when the ordinary value underflows.

minimum_resolvable_probability.description: Smallest probability the counted null can resolve. Below it the estimate comes from the fitted tail model, reported as support_status supported_tail_model.

pair_tail_log_probability.description: Natural logarithm of pair_tail_probability; authoritative when the ordinary probability underflows. Omitted only when a legacy calibration retained no stable log coordinate.

pair_tail_probability.description: Qualified null probability for one target pair at least as extreme as the observed score. This is not an E-value and is not database-size adjusted.

pair_tail_surprisal_bits.description: Null-normalized information -log2(pair_tail_probability). This is a measurement, not a homology posterior.

searched_sequence_count.description: Sequences actually searched after any metadata filter. expected_false_hits is scaled to this, so it stays comparable across filtered and unfiltered searches.

holdout_exceedance_count.description: Held-out observations the goodness-of-fit test used. Read the KS distance with this; the distance alone means little without the sample size behind it.

threshold_score.description: Lower bound of the fitted tail region. Extrapolation is only actually used once the counted null runs out, which support_status reports as supported_tail_model; a score above this threshold may still be served empirically.

expected_optimizer_steps.description: Exact optimizer-step budget used for admission and pricing. Execution rejects a profile whose resolved plan differs.

private_model_endpoint.description: Stable organization-private endpoint to create or update after training succeeds.

training_profile_url.description: Organization-private Foundry file URL containing an exact trainer.local_profile.v1 document. Relative dataset and cache paths resolve against the configured local trainer repository.

artifacts.description: Artifact name to organization-private Foundry file URL.

is_training_reused.description: True when this request reused a previously completed deterministic trainer run and incurred zero optimizer-step usage.

endpoint.description: Stable private endpoint accepted by runs.create.

run.description: The exact runs.create contract for this private endpoint.

is_ema.description: True when the serving weights are the complete EMA state selected by the pinned trainer spec.

manifest.description: Pinned trainer.manifest.v1 artifact that names and hashes every checkpoint payload.

source_uri.description: Immutable source checkpoint prefix retained for scientific provenance; never sent to an inference provider.

spec.description: Optional pinned trainer spec needed to reconstruct the serving architecture.

evidence.description: Evidence depth; omit for pairwise_sequence_alignment.

query.description: Typed protein-sequence query used by homology and single-chain MSA endpoints.

RunEndpointRafflesiaHomologyInputHomolog.description: Recursive metadata predicate defining the eligible target population. Field/operator compatibility and limits come from the immutable filter schema for the selected release. Missing/null and negative predicate behavior follows Turbopuffer semantics for every advertised field type.

candidates.description: Ranked retrieval candidates. These are measurements, not asserted homologs.

is_result_limit_reached.description: True when additional ranked targets existed beyond limit. False means the returned list exhausted the searched population.

attributes.description: Requested release-backed target attributes. Unrequested attributes are omitted.

id.description: Stable target record id within the selected immutable database release.

sequence.description: Canonical amino-acid sequence from the selected immutable database release.

affected_candidate_count.description: Returned candidates missing this evidence class.

candidate_count.description: Returned candidates carrying this evidence class.

is_requested_evidence_complete.description: Whether this response carried every evidence class the request contracted for. It is not a statement that significance arrived: significance defaults to if_available, and a release with no qualified calibration honors that contract by omitting it, so this remains true while significance.status is unavailable. Read significance.status for that, and ranking.comparability to learn whether the returned scores can be thresholded at all.

sequence_identity_ratio.description: Identical residue count divided by aligned residue count.

target_space_id.description: Immutable reusable target-space identity when this search consumed one.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC instant at which the server completed this search. A cached scientific result still reports the instant this response was produced.

server_version.description: Version of the API server that produced this response.

is_cache_hit.description: Whether the completed scientific result was reused from a prior identical execution.

queue_wait_ms.description: Time spent waiting for execution capacity, in integer milliseconds.

search_execution_ms.description: Time spent executing the resolved search, in integer milliseconds.

server_total_ms.description: Total time spent serving the request, in integer milliseconds, including queueing.

comparability.description: Whether primary_measurement is interpretable beyond this one ordering. within_query_only means the scores rank these candidates against each other and nothing else: they are not comparable across queries, carry no null model, and an unrelated sequence can produce a higher top score than a true homolog, so no score threshold is meaningful. cross_query_calibrated means a qualified calibration produced significance for every returned candidate, and significance.measurements is the field to threshold on.

id.description: Opaque content-addressed identity of the complete canonical search outcome.

sha256.description: Digest of the exact retained canonical outcome-receipt bytes.

reason.description: Why significance is missing. no_qualified_calibration is also the unavailable_reason the release catalog publishes for the same release, so the two surfaces name this with one string.

bit_score.description: Database-size-independent score from the fitted tail: (lambda*raw_score - ln k)/ln 2. When support_status is supported_tail_model the identity expected_false_hits = searched_sequence_count * 2^-bit_score holds exactly. In the counted regime the probability comes from the empirical null instead, so treat bit_score there as the same score on a comparable scale, not as a restatement of expected_false_hits.

e_value_calibration_id.description: Immutable E-value model identity; distinct from the enclosing augmented calibration_id.

e_value_conditioning_context_id.description: Identity of the pre-score query covariates used by a conditional model.

e_value_estimand.description: Null count represented by expected_false_hits, such as exhaustive target hits or rows reported by one frozen procedure.

e_value_method.description: Exact qualified construction used for expected_false_hits.

e_value_tail_coordinate.description: Standardized conditional-tail excess used to enforce the qualified support boundary.

expected_false_hits.description: Qualified expected null-hit count for the declared E-value estimand and exact searched inventory. Comparable in units, but not model assumptions, to a BLAST E-value.

is_family_wise_lower_bound.description: True when a null replay frontier truncated above this score, making family_wise_exceedance_probability a lower bound.

log_expected_false_hits.description: Natural logarithm of expected_false_hits; authoritative when the ordinary value underflows.

minimum_resolvable_probability.description: Smallest probability the counted null can resolve. Below it the estimate comes from the fitted tail model, reported as support_status supported_tail_model.

pair_tail_log_probability.description: Natural logarithm of pair_tail_probability; authoritative when the ordinary probability underflows. Omitted only when a legacy calibration retained no stable log coordinate.

pair_tail_probability.description: Qualified null probability for one target pair at least as extreme as the observed score. This is not an E-value and is not database-size adjusted.

pair_tail_surprisal_bits.description: Null-normalized information -log2(pair_tail_probability). This is a measurement, not a homology posterior.

searched_sequence_count.description: Sequences actually searched after any metadata filter. expected_false_hits is scaled to this, so it stays comparable across filtered and unfiltered searches.

holdout_exceedance_count.description: Held-out observations the goodness-of-fit test used. Read the KS distance with this; the distance alone means little without the sample size behind it.

threshold_score.description: Lower bound of the fitted tail region. Extrapolation is only actually used once the counted null runs out, which support_status reports as supported_tail_model; a score above this threshold may still be served empirically.

component_id.description: Caller-defined identifier for one distinct sequence component.

sequence.description: Protein sequence for which the server builds a generic MSA before pairing.

stoichiometry.description: Number of identical copies declared in the complex A3M header. Defaults to 1; it does not duplicate rows or change pairing assignments.

grouping_key.description: Identifier used to group rows across components. Defaults to taxonomy_id.

is_conflicting_group_excluded.description: Whether to exclude groups whose rows carry conflicting taxonomy identifiers. Defaults to false; conflicts are measured either way.

matching.description: Rule used when a group contains multiple rows for a component. Defaults to rank_order.

maximum_paired_rows.description: Maximum paired rows retained. Defaults to 8192.

maximum_unpaired_rows_per_component.description: Maximum preserved unpaired rows per component. Defaults to 8192.

strategy.description: complete requires every component in a paired row; greedy requires at least two. Defaults to complete.

taxonomy_nodes_object_id.description: Pinned NCBI taxonomy dump required when taxonomy_rank is set.

taxonomy_rank.description: Optional NCBI rank to which taxonomy identifiers are lifted before grouping.

complex_a3m.description: Query, paired rows, and preserved unpaired rows in the generic complex A3M dialect.

complex_query_length.description: Total concatenated query width in residues.

component_break_columns.description: Zero-based first column of every component after the first.

manifest.description: Content-addressed inputs, resolved parameters, measurements, and artifact bindings.

msa_configuration_id.description: Resolved immutable search configuration used to generate every component MSA.

row_assignments.description: Per-source-row grouping key and paired-row assignment.

component_id.description: Caller-defined identifier for this distinct sequence component.

msa_id.description: Generated immutable generic MSA resource for this component.

sequence.description: Normalized protein sequence used for homology search.

stoichiometry.description: Number of identical copies recorded in the complex A3M header.

is_neff_exact.description: False when the paired block was too large to reweight exactly within the synchronous work budget, in which case the deterministic sampled method was used.

neff_standard_error.description: Uncertainty on an estimated Neff. Zero when the value is exact.

paired_homolog_neff.description: Paired Neff excluding the query's own weight.

paired_neff.description: Effective sequence count of the paired block under exact identity reweighting.

candidate_group_count.description: Groups observed across all components before the strategy and matching rules were applied.

conflicting_group_count.description: Groups whose members disagree on taxonomy id, measured whether or not they were excluded.

conflicting_paired_rows.description: Paired rows contributed by conflicting groups, and therefore pairing different organisms.

excluded_unresolved_rank_rows.description: Rows carrying a taxonomy id whose lineage never reached the requested grouping rank. Dropped rather than grouped on their raw id.

is_truncated_by_row_cap.description: The paired block hit maximum_paired_rows and lower-ranked groups were dropped.

affinity_binder_id.description: Ligand entity id used by an affinity-capable backend.

constraints.description: Backend-native constraint object; unsupported mappings fail explicitly.

model_msa_id.description: Typed model-native MSA resource. Boltz-2 accepts b2msa_; Chai-1 accepts c1msa_. Mutually exclusive with MSA file URLs.

model_type.description: AlphaFold2 model type; auto chooses monomer or multimer.

msa_server_url.description: HTTPS ColabFold-compatible MSA service URL for explicit mmseqs2 modes.

chain_id.description: Protein entity id associated with this alignment.

is_complex.description: The file is a concatenated complex A3M with a length/cardinality header.

pairing_csv_url.description: Optional key,sequence pairing CSV file URL.

url.description: A3M or aligned FASTA file URL.

ccd.description: One or more ligand CCD codes; mutually exclusive with smiles.

id.description: Unique chain or molecule identifier.

sequence.description: Polymer sequence for protein, DNA, or RNA entities.

smiles.description: Ligand SMILES; mutually exclusive with ccd.

ccd.description: Chemical Component Dictionary code for the modified residue.

artifact_urls.description: Provider artifact name to ordinary URL.

collapsed_duplicate_rows.description: Rows removed because normalized target ids were repeated.

columns_with_no_residue.description: Query columns occupied by no homolog row.

homolog_neff.description: Sum of sequence weights over non-query homolog rows.

homolog_row_count.description: Number of non-query homolog rows after optional target-id collapse.

is_pairwise_diagnostics_estimated.description: True when pairwise comparable/similar/identity diagnostics are estimates from deterministic samples.

mean_column_entropy_bits.description: Mean Shannon entropy of non-gap homolog residues, in bits.

mean_column_occupancy.description: Mean residue occupancy over homolog rows and query columns; excludes the query row.

mean_identity_to_query.description: Mean ungapped identity to the query over homolog rows.

mean_row_coverage.description: Mean occupied-query-column fraction over homolog rows; excludes the query.

neff.description: Sum of inverse-neighborhood sequence weights, including the query. Consult is_neff_exact and neff_standard_error.

neff_sequence_ratio.description: Neff divided by total sequence count; lower values indicate more redundancy.

neff_standard_error.description: Delta-method estimated standard error for sampled Neff; zero for exact Neff.

occupied_insertion_slots.description: Query-boundary insertion slots occupied by at least one homolog.

pair_sample_count.description: Number of directed row-partner samples evaluated by the sampled method; zero for exact weighting.

pair_sampling_fraction.description: Fraction of all directed row pairs evaluated by the sampled method; zero for exact weighting.

pairwise_comparable_pairs.description: Pairs meeting the minimum overlap threshold and sharing at least one residue.

pairwise_comparisons.description: All unordered MSA row pairs, including pairs involving the query.

pairwise_mean_overlap_fraction.description: Mean jointly occupied query-column fraction over comparable pairs.

pairwise_pooled_identity.description: Identical jointly occupied residues divided by all jointly occupied residues over comparable pairs.

pairwise_similar_pairs.description: Comparable pairs meeting the identity threshold.

redundant_aligned_sequence_rows.description: Rows represented by an already-seen aligned state during exact weighting.

sampling_seed.description: Seed used by deterministic sampling; zero when exact weighting was used.

sequence_count.description: Total MSA depth including the query row.

unique_aligned_sequences.description: Distinct query-column state strings including the query.

weighted_mean_column_entropy_bits.description: Mean Shannon entropy after exact sequence reweighting, in bits.

weighted_mean_column_occupancy.description: Mean column occupancy weighted by the selected sequence weights; excludes the query.

weighting_kernel_comparisons.description: Unique aligned-state comparisons actually evaluated after exact duplicate-state grouping.

lane_urls.description: Alignment role to ordinary A3M URL.

output_format.description: Inline embedding output defaults to json. File batches require npz.

salience.description: Optional learned per-residue weights emitted by fine-tuned retrieval models.

RunEndpointUnknownOutput.description: Forward-compatible output for an endpoint published after this contract was generated.

post.description: Runs one typed protein query against one resolved immutable database release and returns completed ranked candidates and requested evidence directly. Candidates are retrieval measurements, not asserted homologs. This bounded stateless operation returns at most 5,000 rows inline. POST /v1/runs with endpoint rafflesia/homology executes the same scientific contract but adds the uniform retained-run resource, provenance, billing, and optional background/event lifecycle. parameters.description: Start date in ISO8601 format (for example, '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z' or '2025-01-01'). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

schema.description: Start date in ISO8601 format (for example, '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z' or '2025-01-01'). Defaults to 24 hours ago.

parameters.description: Exclusive end date in ISO8601 format (for example, '2025-02-01T00:00:00Z' or '2025-02-01'). Defaults to the current time.

parameters.description: Timezone used for date aggregation and boundaries. Response timestamps are UTC.

parameters.description: Aggregation timeframe for time-series data. When omitted it is selected from the date span: minute below 2 hours, hour below 2 days, day below 64 days, week below 183 days, otherwise month.

post.description: Creates one retained run for any endpoint. By default the request executes the exact pinned endpoint release and waits for completion. Set background=true to enqueue the identical normalized request and return the same resource shape immediately. A background run may select one existing webhook_endpoint_id; raw callback URLs are not accepted. Endpoint-specific input and output JSON Schemas are published on the endpoint descriptor. File-like inputs and outputs use URLs. Idempotent retries replay the original create status, body, and Rafflesia response headers.

parameters.description: Retry identity for foreground or background creation. The original status, body, and Rafflesia response headers are replayed exactly; a different complete create request returns a conflict.
parameters.name: Idempotency-Key

schema.description: Retry identity for foreground or background creation. The original status, body, and Rafflesia response headers are replayed exactly; a different complete create request returns a conflict.

parameters.description: Caller start deadline in seconds. Queue wait and failed attempts count; execution may continue after a runner starts.
parameters.name: Rafflesia-Request-Timeout

schema.description: Caller start deadline in seconds. Queue wait and failed attempts count; execution may continue after a runner starts.

parameters.description: Best-effort affinity hint for a warm execution worker. It never blocks fallback to another worker.
parameters.name: Rafflesia-Runner-Hint

schema.description: Best-effort affinity hint for a warm execution worker. It never blocks fallback to another worker.

parameters.description: Background queue priority. Low-priority runs start after normal-priority work for the same endpoint.
parameters.name: Rafflesia-Queue-Priority

schema.description: Background queue priority. Low-priority runs start after normal-priority work for the same endpoint.

parameters.description: JSON object whose initial_acl and expiration_duration_seconds apply to every file produced by this run.

schema.description: JSON object whose initial_acl and expiration_duration_seconds apply to every file produced by this run.

parameters.description: Set to 0 to prevent retention of JSON request and response payloads. Generated files remain governed by the object lifecycle preference.
parameters.name: Rafflesia-Store-IO

schema.description: Set to 0 to prevent retention of JSON request and response payloads. Generated files remain governed by the object lifecycle preference.

parameters.description: Set to 1, true, or yes to disable automatic retries. This takes precedence over Rafflesia-Retry-Config.
parameters.name: Rafflesia-No-Retry

schema.description: Set to 1, true, or yes to disable automatic retries. This takes precedence over Rafflesia-Retry-Config.

parameters.description: JSON retry budgets for server_error, timeout, and connection_error. Each retries value counts additional attempts; ten total attempts is the ceiling.
parameters.name: Rafflesia-Retry-Config

schema.description: JSON retry budgets for server_error, timeout, and connection_error. Each retries value counts additional attempts; ten total attempts is the ceiling.

parameters.description: Accepted for portability. Rafflesia never substitutes an unpinned endpoint, so fallback is already disabled.
